items.details: Picturesque city on Lake Constance; famed summer Bregenz Festival performs operas on a floating lakeside stage
items.name: Bregenz floating lakeside stage

items.details: Cable car up Pfänder mountain; views of Lake Constance and 240+ Alpine peaks; panoramic restaurant on top
items.name: Pfänderbahn cable car

items.details: Lakeside restaurant; modern European fare (seafood paella, potato gnocchi with basil pesto); set lunch menu is great value
items.name: Pier 69

items.details: Uber-modern contemporary art museum on the Bregenz Culture Mile; rotating exhibitions (Warhol, Weiwei, Antony Gormley shown in the past)
items.name: Kunsthaus Bregenz (KUB)
items.price_hint: €11 adult; €9 concessions; combined KUB + vorarlberg museum ticket €17 (€12 under-25s)

items.details: Modern building housing the state's art and cultural treasures: archaeology, folklore, art history
items.name: vorarlberg museum

items.details: Bus from Bregenz to the village of Mellau, the base for nights 1-4
items.name: Bus 37 or 35, Bregenz to Mellau

items.details: Green-shuttered hotel on the village square; in-house sauna with outdoor terrace, library, excellent buffet breakfast; budget alternative named: Gästehaus Meusburger in Bezau (from €58/room/night)
items.name: Hotel Bären, Mellau
items.price_hint: From €50/night per person based on 2 sharing, incl. buffet breakfast, sauna, free parking, free Bregenzerwald Guest Card on 3+ night summer stays

items.details: Free guided tour along the Umgang Bregenzerwald trail organised by the tourism office; passes Bergkäserei Schoppernau (cheese sampling), farmhouses, old sawmill, white parish church with black onion dome
items.name: Umgang Bregenzerwald guided village trail

items.details: William Morris-designed 1890s hunting lodge; wooden staircase with taxidermy, Wes Anderson-like fireplace; guided tours in summer via Hotel Adler
items.name: Villa Maund

items.details: Lunch stop with outdoor seating; Wiener Schnitzel with fries (€10.90), Bregenzerwald Kässpätzle with potato salad (€9.50)
items.name: Alphof Rossstelle

items.details: Seven unique bus stops designed by acclaimed international architects (Belgium, Spain, Russia, Norway, China, Japan, Chile) built by local craftsmen
items.name: BUS:STOP Krumbach

items.details: Family-run chalet-style hotel restaurant; classic Kässpätzle with Bergkäse and Räßkäse (€15 with green salad), pork medallions in creamy mushroom sauce with spätzle (€18.90); 3-course menu with wine €38.90
items.name: Gasthof Adler, Lingenau

items.details: Bus 40 to Bezau, then gondola up to Baumgarten; transport covered by the free Bregenzerwald Guest Card (issued free by hotel on 3+ night stays)
items.name: Bus 40 Mellau to Bezau; Bezau Seilbahn gondola

items.details: 1.5-hour panorama hike with scenic vantage points; views of Lake Constance on clear days
items.name: Baumgarten panorama hike

items.details: Mountain inn at end of the panorama hike; log fire, glass of wine, homemade mountain-cheese platter
items.name: Bergrestaurant Niedere

items.details: Retro chairlift ride down to the village of Andelsbuch through meadows and timber buildings
items.name: Nostalgic chairlift down to Andelsbuch

items.details: Minimalist glass building by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor; exhibitions of regional craftsmanship; shop with member-made goods
items.name: Werkraumhaus Bregenzerwald
items.price_hint: €7.50 adult; €5 students; free for 15 and under; open Tue-Sat 10am-6pm, closed Mon/Sun/holidays

items.details: Old inn turned modern café/bar; toasted paninis and local Egger beer on tap; regular live music
items.name: Jöslar Inn

items.details: Bus to Lech, the final base of the trip
items.location: Mellau to Lech am Arlberg, Austria
items.name: Bus 40 Mellau Zentrum to Lech Schlosskopf

items.details: Cosy comfortable hotel with mountain views, kitchenette, onsite sauna/steam bath/solarium/chill-out room; fridge can be stocked before arrival on request; SPAR supermarket nearby
items.name: Haus Braunarl

items.details: Inclusive card: public transport, summer cable cars, Lake Spullersee and Lake Formarinsee visits, forest swimming pool, bowling in bad weather
items.name: Lech Card

items.details: Panorama bus (covered by Lech Card) to Formarinsee Lake; easy ~1 hour lakeside hike around the lake to the Freiburger Hütte alpine hut
items.location: Zugertal valley, Lech am Arlberg, Austria
items.name: Formarinsee Lake hike to Freiburger Hütte

items.details: Alpine mountain hut lunch: grilled sausage with mustard, shredded horseradish and bread, washed down with local beer
items.name: Freiburger Hütte

items.details: Ride up and down Rüfikopf for panoramic views of Lech am Arlberg and the Tannberg hiking region above Oberlech; ride covered by Lech Card
items.name: Cable car Lech to Rüfikopf (2350m)

items.details: Starting point for the first stage of the Green Ring and the Geoweg Rüfikopf trail; short hike down to Monzabonsee lake
items.name: Rüfikopf hikes and Monzabonsee lake

items.details: 360-degree view restaurant; Rösti (potato pancake) with crispy bacon and alp cheese; spaghetti bolognese; Friday sunset journeys with sparkling wine reception/panorama fondue evenings
items.name: Rüfikopf panorama restaurant

items.details: Schlegelkopf chairlift from Lech then 30-min scenic walk to gypsum-hole karst formations; marmot colony; 20 species of orchids (bloom July-mid-August)
items.name: Gipslöcher nature reserve, Oberlech

items.details: James Turrell walk-in light-and-space art installation; evening sunset light performance (~45 min) with colour-changing light on walls and ceiling
items.name: Skyspace Lech
items.price_hint: Tickets €15; book via skyspace-lech.com; dome closed in bad weather

itineraries.summary: A free 5-day miniguide to Austria's westernmost state, Vorarlberg, built around wooden-architecture villages, alpine hikes and mountain huts. Base 1: Bregenz on Lake Constance, then 4 nights in the village of Mellau exploring the Bregenzerwald, finishing in the mountain resort of Lech am Arlberg with cable-car hikes to Rüfikopf and Oberlech. Includes per-stop restaurants, museum ticket prices, and free-transit guest cards (Bregenzerwald Guest Card, Lech Card).
itineraries.title: BudgetTraveller's Guide to Vorarlberg: A 5 day itinerary

itineraries.destination: Phuket, Thailand (Phuket Old Town, Chalong, Patong, Nai Harn)

items.details: Morning coffee and breakfast in a restored Sino-Portuguese shophouse with gallery and gift shop; Japanese-style cafe, breakfast snacks and sweet treats
items.location: 125 Soi Soon Utis, Phuket Old Town, Thailand
items.name: Sri the Shophouse Cafe

items.details: Museum of Phuket's Chinese heritage and tin-mining history, former Thai-Chinese school; short walk from the cafe. Alternative named: The Peranakan Phuket Museum (124/1 Moo 1, Sri Soonthorn, Thalang; Peranakan heritage, photo studio in traditional costumes)
items.location: 28 Krabi Rd, Phuket Old Town, Thailand
items.name: Phuket Thai Hua Museum
items.price_hint: 200 THB (~£4.50) adults; Peranakan museum 300 THB (~£7), audio guides included

items.details: Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant with retro 1950s look; Southern Thai classics: gaeng poo (crab curry with rice noodles), kaeng som (tangy Southern Thai curry), Phuket-style braised pork belly. Cash only; arrive before 12:30 to beat the lunch rush. Alternative named: KOPITIAM By Wilai (Massaman curry, Hokkien Mee)
items.location: 48/1 Thep Krasattri Rd, Phuket Old Town, Thailand
items.name: One Chun Cafe & Restaurant

items.details: Afternoon panoramic views over Phuket Town; resident macaques (do not feed, keep distance, no food bags). Tunk-ka Cafe at the viewpoint for a cold beer (prices slightly inflated)
items.name: Khao Rang Viewpoint (Monkey Hill)
items.price_hint: Free viewpoint; local songthaew 30-40 THB or Grab taxi to get there

items.details: Historic boutique hotel dating to 1929 (former 'Un Un Hotel'); famous as the Bangkok backpacker hostel in the film 'The Beach'; Sino-Portuguese architecture, small history museum on site; near the famous night market
items.location: 19 Phangnga Rd, Phuket Old Town, Thailand
items.name: The Memory at ON ON Hotel

items.details: Dinner; famous for fondue; international and Thai dishes; Penang beef curry and Massaman curry praised; attentive service, excellent value
items.name: Naya Restaurant & Bar, Rawai

items.details: Morning visit to a responsible elephant sanctuary (created late 2023 by Kong and Louise Rogerson) rescuing female elephants; observation and feeding only, no riding or bathing; 35 acres of natural forest in Chalong; 4-5 hour tour incl. briefing video, banana feeding, forest walk with mahouts, and Thai buffet lunch by the mahouts' wives
items.name: Hidden Garden Elephant Sanctuary
items.price_hint: Tours from ~2,800 THB (~£65) incl. pickup and lunch; most expensive item on the itinerary

items.details: Phuket's largest and most important Buddhist temple (1 of 29 on the island); honours Luang Pho Chaem and Luang Pho Chuang. Dress code: cover shoulders and knees (sarongs borrowable at entrance)
items.name: Wat Chalong Temple (Wat Chaiyathararam)

items.details: Afternoon at the island's only rum distillery; French couple fusing French-Caribbean rum-making with Thai heritage; French copper equipment, organic cane juice rums with local ingredients (lemongrass, Thai sweet basil); guided tours, drink-making classes, tastings and signature cocktails, onsite restaurant/bar
items.name: The Distillery Phuket - Chalong Bay

items.details: Evening authentic Muay Thai boxing in Patong (Patong Boxing Stadium / Bangla Boxing Stadium); pre-fight rituals, in-house band, drinks to your seat; front-row seats recommended
items.name: Patong Muay Thai Boxing
items.price_hint: Ringside from 2,100 THB (~£42-47); standard 1,500 THB (~£28-35); free T-shirt memento

items.details: Full relaxation day at a crescent-shaped beach with pristine white sand and laid-back vibe; protected by local regulations (no jet skis, vendors or big resorts); viewpoint with swing at the south end
items.name: Nai Harn Beach
items.price_hint: Beachfront pad thai/fried rice 80-120 THB; bring own water and snacks

items.details: Sunset beach hopping: Kata beach sunsets; Promthep Cape & Windmill Viewpoint at the southernmost tip (~30 min drive from Kata) for Andaman Sea and Nai Harn Beach views
items.name: Kata Beach and Promthep Cape

items.details: Recommended stay in Rawai: forest-surrounded oasis, two quiet pool areas, onsite spa with sauna/steam/massage, onsite bar; restaurant (Thai + Indian dishes) planned; spacious comfortable rooms with some balconies; short walk to Nai Harn beach
items.name: Nai Harn Collective
items.price_hint: Positioned as a budget option for Rawai/Phuket

itineraries.summary: A 3-day Phuket itinerary built for rainy days, planned with HipTraveler's itinerary planner, spotlighting lesser-known corners of the island. Day 1 explores Phuket Old Town's Sino-Portuguese architecture, museums and Michelin-recognised Southern Thai food. Day 2 covers a responsible elephant sanctuary, Wat Chalong temple, the island's only rum distillery and a Muay Thai boxing night. Day 3 is relaxation at Nai Harn and Kata beaches.
itineraries.title: 3 days in Phuket - Rainy day itinerary

extractions.notes: Kash Bhattacharya runs budgettraveller.org alongside IG; the blog is his itinerary machine (day-by-day guides with named hotels, restaurants, activities and prices). Also publishes '48 hours in X' guides (Cologne, Bologna cited) but only the three fully day-structured itineraries were extracted.

Professional adventure/travel photographer (Vancouver-based). IG feed is single stunning landscape photos with short captions that occasionally include a day-trip tip (e.g. Meteora as a day trip from Athens with an overnight stay tip; Oeschinensee alpine-loop hike clockwise tip with mountain-hut cash tip; Inside Passage cruise mentions). No named trip plans, day-by-day guides, hotel/restaurant lists or structured itineraries were found in web or social search results — only photos with brief tips. Per honesty rules, no itinerary was forced.

itineraries.summary: Bob Wells's 4-day family road trip through Utah's red rock country with his son Robert, Deb and her sister Ann (who planned the itinerary). Route: Moab/Arches to Goblin Valley State Park and Capitol Reef NP (overnight in Torrey), then down UT-95 past Hite Overlook and the Moki Dugway to Goosenecks State Park and Monument Valley. A trip narrative with a clear stop sequence rather than a published guide.
itineraries.title: Road Trip with my Son and his Girlfriend

extractions.notes: Bob Wells publishes trip narratives and route overviews on cheaprvliving.com rather than day-by-day guides. The Grand Circle is a route loop with named stops (no dates or day structure); the son road trip is a 4-day narrative route. Both qualify as medium-confidence itineraries but carry minimal hotel/restaurant specifics.

Sarah writes slow-travel essays on Substack (substack.com/@culturalexplorer), e.g. a piece on ADO bus travel in Mexico (three journeys: Mexico City to Oaxaca, Oaxaca to Puebla, Puebla to the airport, with booking tips via the ADO Móvil app) and a future-trip sketch (fly to Mexico City for a few nights, time in Oaxaca city, then the coast via the new highway to Puerto Escondido). Well-researched transport commentary but no day-by-day itinerary, hotel/restaurant recommendations or structured trip plan found. Per honesty rules, no itinerary was forced.

Jack Morris's doyoutravel brand is photography/presets-focused (the @doyoutravelpresets account sells Lightroom presets). Web and social search results show stunning travel photos and interviews about photo technique, but no trip plans, guides, named itineraries or structured hotel/activity recommendations. Per honesty rules, no itinerary was forced.
